book.name: Maaron Igham Mulin Yes Israela
book.title: Maaron Igham Mulin Yes Israela Pa Pataŋani Todi Kisim Bek—Eksodus

content: Maaron ipariaaŋ saveeŋ mbuaaŋ toni muul

Tovenen Yoova isaav pa Mose ighaze: “Aazne, yom pale ughita katin ŋgar to you pale nagham pa kinik to Isip. You pale napatooŋ tapirig tiina pani, leso ipul yes Israela tila. Ye pale ighita katin you tapirig le isob, ghoro izurun gham aghau pa ndug toni.”
Ve Maaron isaav pa Mose muul ighaze: “You Yoova nanepneep.
Muuŋ, sawa to navot to Abaram, Isak, ve Yakop, navotia taug padi naghaze: You Maaron Ariaŋag To Nalib Pa Ndimaronŋa Tisob. Eemoghon izag Yoova, nene navotia padi maau. Mbnp 17:1, 26:24, 28:13+
Ve nambua saveeŋ toman di naghaze yeiŋa pale nilup ghei ninim ee moghon, ve nagham taan to yes Kanaana to tineep tinim loomba pani ne, inim ledi. Mbnp 12:7; Hib 11:8+
“Aazne, yes Israela titaŋ tiina pasa, yes Isipa tighamgham samin di, ve tighurghur pataŋani naol padi. Eemoghon taŋiiz todi, you nalooŋa wa. Ve matag iŋgalŋgal saveeŋ mbuaaŋ tiou. Igham 2:24

“Tovenen yom ula ve uvotia aliŋag pa yes Israela ughaze: ‘You Yoova nanepneep. Aazne, yam anim mbesooŋa sorok pa yes Isipa, ve titatan gham pa tapiridi, ve lemim ataam eta maau. Eemoghon you pale nagham mbeb gharatooŋadi tintina pida, leso nagham mulin gham ila yes Isipa nimadi. Pale napatooŋ tapirig tiina ivot ighazooŋ, ve naghur atia iŋarua yes Isipa pa sosor todi. Leso napas gham avot pa pataŋani tiam.

Ve you pale nagham gham anim tamtoghon tiou, ve you Yoova nanim Maaron tiam. Ve yam pale awatag katin ghou, ve aghazooŋ pa gabuag toman ŋgar tiou. Pasa, uraat to naghaze nagham payam, nene pale ipatooŋ gham pa ŋgar tiou. Onoon, aazne yes Isipa titatan gham pa tapiridi. Eemoghon you pale nagham mulin gham ila nimadi, ve nagharaat ataam payam, leso apul ndug todi ve ala.

Muuŋ, you nambua saveeŋ ve napariaaŋa le iyaryaaŋ kat naghaze you pale nagham taan to yes Kanaana inim Abaram, Isak, ve Yakop ledi. Tovenen you pale nagham gham ala avot taan tonowen, ve naghami inim lemim, leso aneep tonowe itaghoni taghoni gha ila. Pasa, you Yoova nanepneep.’”

Yoova isavia saveeŋ tonene le isob, ghoro Mose ila ipaesia Yoova aliŋa pa yes Israela. Eemoghon uraat pataŋani to yes tighamghami, nene itatan di le tapiridi isob kat. Tovenen lolodi pa tilooŋ saveeŋ toni maau.
Ghoro Yoova isaav pa Mose muul ighaze: “Ula ughita kinik to Isip, ve usaav pani ughaze iyok pa yes Israela, leso tipul taan toni ve tila.”
Eemoghon Mose ipamuul Yoova aliŋa ighaze: “You ŋgeu to savsaveeŋ maau. Ighaze yes Israela tilooŋ saveeŋ tiou maau, nene kinik paam, irau ilooŋ ghou maau.” Igham 4:10
Ghoro Yoova isaav pa Mose yesuru Aron ighaze timuul tila to yes Israela ve kinik to Isip. Ve ighur uraat pa yesuru ighaze tigham yes Israela tipul Isip ve tila.
Pitiiŋ to Mose yesuru Aron
Nene yes Israela pughudi. Yakop natu aidaba iza Ruben. Ve Ruben ndinatu, nene Anok, Palu, Ezron, ve Karmi. Yes tonene tivot tinim ival, ve muri ghoro tinim rumai paaŋ.
Yakop natu Simeon ndinatu, nene Yemuel, Yamin, Oat, Yakin, Zoar, ve Saul. (Saul tina, ye Kanaan tidi.) Yes tonene to tivot ila to Simeon. Yes tivot tinim ival, ve muri ghoro tinim rumai liim ve eez.
Yakop natu Levi ndinatu izadi, nene Gerson, Koat, ve Merari. Levi ineep irau ndaman 137, ve imaat.
Gerson ndinatu, nene Libni ve Simei.
Koat ndinatu, nene Amram, Izar, Ebron, ve Usiel. Koat ineep irau ndaman 133, ve imaat.
Merari ndinatu, nene Mali ve Musi. Yes tonene to tivot ila to Levi. Nene pitiiŋ to Levi toman papaghu toni. Yes tivot tinim ival, ve muri ghoro tinim rumai tol.
Amram ivai wagha liva Yokopet. Ve Yokopet ipoop Aron yesuru Mose. Amram ineep irau ndaman 137, ve imaat.
Izar ndinatu, nene Kora, Nepek, ve Zikri.
Ve Usiel ndinatu, nene Misael, Elzapan, ve Sitri.
Aron ivai Eliseba to Aminadap natu liva, ye Nason livu. Eliseba yesuru Aron tipoop paaŋ: Nadap, Abiu, Eleasar, ve Itamar.
Kora ndinatu, nene Asir, Elkana, ve Abiasap. Kora ndinatu tol tonene tivot tinim ival, ve muri ghoro tinim rumai tol.
Aron natu Eleasar ivai Putiel natu liva, ve tipoop Pineas. Yes tonene to Levi papaghu toni, ve tinim daba pa rumai todi todi.

Nenen Aron yesuru Mose pughudi. Yoova ighur yesuru pa timuuŋ pa yes Israela, ve tigham di tipul Isip, ve tilaagh ila rouŋ rouŋ itaghon rumai todi todi, ve tila pa taan Kanaan. Ve yesuru to tisaav pa kinik to Isip tighaze iyok padi leso tigham yes Israela tipul Isip ve tila.
Sawa to Mose inepneep izi Isip, Yoova isaav pani ighaze: “You Yoova nanepneep. Saveeŋ isob to you nasavia payom, yom irau usavia pa kinik to yes Isipa leso ilooŋa.”
Eemoghon Mose isaav pa Yoova ighaze: “You ŋgeu to savsaveeŋ maau. Pale kinik ilooŋ ghou vena?” Igham 4:10, 6:12
